cohort: 9588 low-risk women who had a singleton vaginal birth at 19 birth centers and 2 hospitals in Tokyo, Japan
finding: While blood loss over 1L was higher in midwife-led birth centers, perineal lacerations were less common, and fewer infants had low Apgar scores compared to hospital births.
mod_finding: This study compared maternal and neonatal outcomes for low-risk women giving birth at midwife-led birth centers versus hospitals in Japan, finding a higher rate of blood loss over 1L but lower incidence of perineal lacerations and better Apgar scores in the birth center group.
